flags.message: CourtListener MCP server returned HTTP 429 (rate limit exceeded, 300/hour, retry in ~855s) on the first and only search call in this cell. The prediction was made from the provisioned inputs, the statpack, and general knowledge without verifying the lower-court opinion or the cited circuit cases. No REST fallback was attempted. If many cells in this fan-out share the sidecar's quota, the throttle likely degraded other cells too.

Snapshot dates the 'Petition for a writ of certiorari filed' entry Apr 08 2026, but the extension ran to May 16 2026, the petition PDF is stamped 2026-05-15, and DocketedDate is May 28 2026. Looks like a supremecourt.gov entry-date artifact; did not affect the forecast. documents.json also records petition.txt as truncated (240 pages), so the appended Third Circuit opinion is only partly present.
